current_password.description: Required when a password is already set
current_password.title: Current Password

DataSource.description: Provenance of a piece of metadata. AI output is never authoritative.
DataSource.title: DataSource

ErrorResponse.description: Envelope returned for every non-2xx response.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

category.description: Storage folder: documents, images, certificates, resumes or other
category.title: Category

document_type.description: User override of the document classification

folder_id.description: Target folder. Use move_to_root to move to the vault root.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

code.description: Authenticator code or a recovery code
code.title: Code

ProcessingStatus.description: Overall lifecycle of a file through the processing pipeline.
ProcessingStatus.title: ProcessingStatus

status.description: ready: all checks pass. degraded: a non-critical dependency (e.g. Qdrant, worker) is down; core features work. not_ready: a critical dependency is down.
status.title: Status

recovery_codes.description: Shown once. Each works a single time.
recovery_codes.title: Recovery Codes

RefreshRequest.description: Body form for non-browser clients. Browsers send the refresh cookie instead.
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

tokens.description: Only returned when the refresh token was sent in the body

id.description: Session (family) id; stable across token refreshes
id.title: Id

SystemInfoResponse.description: Non-sensitive capabilities the clients use to adapt their UI.
SystemInfoResponse.title: SystemInfoResponse

otpauth_uri.description: otpauth:// URI to show as a QR code
otpauth_uri.title: Otpauth Uri

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Finish signing in with an authenticator or recovery code
Turn off two-step verification (needs password and a code)
Confirm a code from the app to turn on two-step verification
Start authenticator-app setup (returns the secret to scan)

put.summary: Set or change your password (signs out your other devices)

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token
Create an account with email and password

delete.summary: Remove a file from a collection

post.summary: Upload a file (multipart/form-data: file, folder_id?, category?)

patch.summary: Rename, move, star or reclassify a file

delete.summary: Permanently delete a trashed file (from storage too)

get.description: Returns 200 while the process is able to serve requests. Performs no I/O.
